negative_trails.action: OpenClaw Gateway set to auto-launch on boot via Windows Startup folder
negative_trails.verification: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand returned entry 'OpenClaw Gateway' pointing to 'OpenClaw Gateway.cmd' in Startup folder
negative_trails.reason: Production stack is Cloudflare Workers (APPS/NET-PET-AI). OpenClaw is a local Node.js dev proxy with no production role. Auto-launching it on boot causes console prompts, port conflicts, and potential freeze symptoms. Violates L55/GODMODE: unnecessary local runtime.

negative_trails.action: Gateway script contains 4 hardcoded API keys (DeepSeek, Cerebras, Groq, Dialagram) exposed in plaintext
negative_trails.verification: Direct file read of gateway.cmd shows all 4 provider keys set as environment variables before Node.js launch
negative_trails.reason: Secrets in plaintext in a startup-launched script is a security anti-pattern. Keys should be in .env with restricted ACLs, not in a .cmd that runs on every boot.

negative_trails.action: OpenClaw Gateway spawned on localhost:18789 with no authentication
negative_trails.verification: gateway.cmd sets OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT=18789 and launches node.exe with no auth middleware
negative_trails.reason: An unauthenticated localhost gateway with model-routing capabilities is a latent prompt-injection/privilege-escalation surface. If a browser tab or local process can reach port 18789, it can invoke paid models.

negative_trails.action: Run 130 DEATH seal marked KILO_HOLLOW with no SOUL receipt (count_before=N/A, count_after=N/A)

negative_trails.reason: KILO_HOLLOW sessions produce no JSONL on disk, but the SOUL content was preserved verbatim in the DEATH markdown. Future runs must not treat N/A as a valid receipt — it creates a data gap in the soulcount chain.
